title: template-bounds (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: Direct and indirect children omit required generic parent arguments. This annotation-completeness concern does not make passing Product to the Entity-bounded store unsafe. Intermediate explicitly propagates its Entity bound. The runtime rejects an unrelated stdClass and accepts Product through both inheritance depths.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Runtime proves native-bound compatibility only, not annotation completeness. The documentation defines supplying generic parent arguments via @extends. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago agrees with the scoped expectation. Both direct and intermediate subclasses accept Product without a bound-compatibility error in this run. All three diagnose only the genuinely omitted generic arguments.
